notes: Select Harvests Limited (SHV) — ASX-listed almond grower / processor. Fiscal year ends 30 September; H1 ends 31 March. Owns and manages ~9,000 ha (~22.4K acres) of almond orchards (Robinvale Vic, Riverland SA, Wemen Vic) plus processing/marketing operation (insertion brand: Lucky, Sunsol, Renshaw etc., progressively divested in favour of bulk almond focus). Bearing trees / orchards are carried on book-cost basis (depreciated cost) under AASB116 — NOT fair value. Crop volume and pricing drive earnings; biological asset (almonds on tree) carried at FV at year-end. Highly cyclical: FY20-FY22 weak almond prices, FY23-FY25 recovery on tighter California crop. Reports almond crop in tonnes and average pool price A$/kg.

periods.notes: 1HFY20: revenue $105M, EBITDA $19M. Lower YoY almond pricing partly offset by higher volumes.
FY20 (year ended 30 Sep 2020): revenue $196.5M, EBITDA $41.6M, NPAT $16.7M. Almond crop 18,420 t at avg pool $7.55/kg.
1HFY21: revenue $80.5M (-23%), EBITDA $9.4M, statutory loss $(2.6)M on weaker almond prices.
FY21: revenue $162.4M, EBITDA $22.5M, statutory loss $(3.6)M. Crop ~15,250 t; avg pool $6.50/kg. Capital raising diluted to 119.5M shares.
1HFY22: revenue $76M, EBITDA $6M, loss $(7)M. Continued weak almond pricing and freight cost pressures.
FY22: revenue $143.0M, EBITDA $0.7M, statutory loss $(22.5)M. Crop ~22,000 t but average pool only $5.50/kg amid global oversupply. No final dividend.
1HFY23: revenue $106M, EBITDA $(3)M, statutory loss $(19.7)M. Trough pricing environment.
FY23: revenue $194.5M, EBITDA $11.6M, statutory loss $(16.5)M. Crop ~22,500 t; avg pool $7.40/kg in recovery from FY22 trough.
1HFY24: revenue $99M, EBITDA $14.5M, near break-even NPAT. Stronger pool pricing momentum.
FY24: revenue $232.5M, EBITDA $31.0M, statutory loss $(10)M. Crop ~21,500 t; avg pool $9.50/kg as California crop tightened. Equity raise lifted shares to ~142M.
1HFY25: revenue $195M, EBITDA $60M, NPAT $26M as almond prices reached cyclical high.
FY25 Annual Report (released 15 Nov 2025): revenue $398.3M, EBITDA $82.4M, NPAT $22M, NAV/share $3.68. Crop ~28,000 t; avg pool ~$11.00/kg. Highest reported earnings since FY20 cycle peak.
